tests.name: Staging build
tests.assertion: Clean build of the staging APK (npm run android:debug:staging) exits 0; APK exists; size + sha256 recorded

tests.name: Identity + guards
tests.assertion: aapt2: staging id/label; staging assets have the staging ref and no prod ref; prod APK the reverse; no default APK allows cleartext; a staging build with a prod VITE_SUPABASE_URL is refused
tests.notes: refusal: STAGING GUARD: REFUSED — VITE_SUPABASE_URL in the process environment (start with --env-file=.env) points at the PRODUCTION project

tests.name: Coexistence
tests.assertion: Both APKs installed side by side; each app has its own storage (a marker set in one is absent in the other)

tests.name: Staging regression subset
tests.assertion: In the staging app: cold start (T4), the 15 routes + 404 (T5), no service worker (T8), safe areas incl. the D1 banner/header geometry (T9), back button (T11)
tests.notes: T4 RAN-PASSED | T5 RAN-PASSED | T8 RAN-PASSED | T9 RAN-PASSED | T11 RAN-PASSED

tests.name: Signup
tests.assertion: A brand-new KSTEST user signs up through the real signup UI of the staging app; lands logged in; the session survives force-stop + relaunch

tests.name: Logout / login
tests.assertion: Log out, log in again with the same mobile number (phone login); an unregistered and a malformed number are refused with the in-app message
tests.notes: unregistered → "इस नंबर से कोई खाता नहीं मिला। कृपया नया खाता बनाएं।"; malformed → "कृपया सही 10 अंकों का मोबाइल नंबर भरें।"; phone login is trust-based (no OTP), lands on /home

tests.name: Post with photo
tests.assertion: As the KSTEST user, post a listing (marker KSTEST…) with a photo; it appears in My Listings and Browse; the detail page shows the photo (naturalWidth > 0) and the photo URL returns 200 from staging storage
tests.notes: photo via Playwright setInputFiles (buffer); listing c57118e3-d3b3-4fb6-a5e2-7145d376274d

tests.name: Contact reveal
tests.assertion: A second KSTEST user reveals the number on user A's listing; logged out, the reveal goes to login with the return path and comes back after login

tests.name: Profile and My Listings
tests.assertion: Both render for the logged-in user; an edited profile field persists after relaunch (pincode behaviour recorded)
tests.notes: KNOWN ISSUE confirmed: saving needs a pincode (first save: "कृपया सही 6 अंकों का पिन कोड भरें।"); saved after entering 470001

tests.name: Cache fills online
tests.assertion: Visiting /, /mausam (Sagar), /msp, /browse and a listing detail online stores an IndexedDB entry for each, with a recent cachedAt

tests.name: Offline with cache
tests.assertion: Airplane mode, force-stop, cold launch: /, /mausam, /msp, /browse and the listing detail show the SAME data as online, with the stamp = stored time; no ErrorBoundary; banner does not cover the header

tests.name: Back online
tests.assertion: Airplane mode off: within 20 s fresh data replaces the cached data and the stamp disappears (app time and the emulator's own reconnect time recorded)
tests.notes: stamp gone + fresh weather after 9839 ms; Android had a network after 2465 ms

tests.name: Freshness policy
tests.assertion: With the stored weather data time set to 30 h ago and mandi data time to 8 days ago, offline: weather numbers hidden with the "too old" message; mandi (policy: 7 days) not shown, the "too old" state instead
tests.notes: policy implemented: weather ≤ 24 h (fetched_at), mandi ≤ 7 days (price_date), listings ≤ 3 days (stored time); older → not shown, "too old" message with the age

tests.name: Offline without cache
tests.assertion: Cache cleared, offline, a freshly chosen place: /mausam and /msp show a clear offline message with a working "try again" within 10–12 s; no spinner remains

tests.name: Privacy
tests.assertion: Every IndexedDB entry and localStorage value written by the cache layer contains none of: the revealed number, either user's number / e-mail / name, auth tokens

tests.name: Cache unit tests
tests.assertion: Node: put/get, expiry by policy, eviction at the cap, quota error swallowed, private URLs never stored, non-200 never stored, key includes Accept/Prefer/Range, key stable

tests.name: Day-change fallback
tests.assertion: Node, fake clock + network: cache filled "yesterday" through the real fetchMandiPrices()/fetchWeatherCell(); a day later offline, mandi returns the cached rows labelled yesterday/older and weather the cell or the policy state

tests.name: Web unchanged
tests.assertion: Cache layer inert without window.Capacitor; npm run build OK; vite preview: page loads, SW registers, no console errors; main-chunk size before (end of 8A) vs after; no new Devanagari outside sanctioned files
tests.notes: main chunk 89.7 KB → 94.5 KB (+4884 B; gzip +1758 B), measured in a temporary worktree of staging d165fbb; v11_phase6.mjs itself exits 1 on Windows (pre-existing: it compares backslash paths to its forward-slash allowlist)

tests.name: Feedback + CORS (staging-local)
tests.assertion: wrangler pages dev on :8788 (+ adb reverse) and the staging-local APK: /grievance POST carries Origin https://localhost, preflight 204 with that Allow-Origin, the form shows success or its documented failure state; other origins get no CORS headers; mic hidden when /transcribe is not configured
tests.notes:
form outcome: failure-with-email-fallback ("अभी यहाँ से संदेश नहीं जा सका। कृपया नीचे के बटन से इसे ईमेल से भेज दें।

ईमेल से भेजें"). functions/api/feedback.js stores only with SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, which this batch may not use, so it answers 503 "unavailable" and the form shows its e-mail fallback.
